# Mohammed Ayeenuddin

> Mohammed Ayeenuddin (Ayeen) is a full stack developer based in Hyderabad, India, and co-founder of Anjeer Labs, an education-first technology company. He builds web applications, SaaS products, and business management software.

## Selected projects

- [Rotana Store Platform](https://rotana-web-app.vercel.app/): Warehouse and franchise management for inventory, supplier workflows, credit ledgers, and deliveries.
- [School Repo](https://schoolrepo.com): School ERP from Anjeer Labs covering students, attendance, fees, payroll, academics, inventory, and role-based permissions.
- [Hamuzair](https://www.hamuzair.com): Custom apparel with AI artwork generation, a live 3D garment customizer, and made-to-order ecommerce.
